power.jaymospowers.darktide.desc: Water and darkness. Guard, parry and answer with a blade; your Flow rises in the deep and in the dark, and at a full bar the tide is yours.
power.jaymospowers.darktide.key.starter: Guard: hold right click (a katana, a knife, or empty hands, which draw a blade of dark water) to block blows from the front for Flow; raise it just as one lands to parry
power.jaymospowers.darktide.key.ability_: Dark Strike (hold): raise your blade overhead, or draw back your fist, and let go to strike; the longer the charge, the harder the blow (full at 1 s). After a parry, wreathed in darkness for a crushing one (25 Flow)
Dark Strike (hold to charge, let go to strike); with a knife, Pounce: hold to raise both blades, let go to leap onto your enemy's back

Katana: Crescent, a wide slash through up to 5 foes (empty hands draw a blade of dark water for it). Knife: Ink Cross, a crossing cut that slows. Always at the legs: people it hits fall crippled. At spring tide Crescent cuts all the way round you
Katana: Crescent. Knife: Fang Barrage (hold): slash everything in front of you, held fast, then stunned. Always at the legs: people it hits fall crippled

Undertow: sink into water, a shadow or rain-wet ground where you look and burst out there, throwing back whoever stands near. Free while you're wet. At spring tide those beside you are dragged under too
Black Tide: a wave of dark water rolls forward, sweeping foes along and blinding them. At spring tide it's twice as wide
Black Tide; with a knife, Riptide Dash (hold %1$s too for a flurry on the first foe)
power.jaymospowers.darktide.key.mode.nig: Shadow Harvest (hold on a corpse): draw its shadow into your hand to raise later (up to 15). A villager rises as itself
power.jaymospowers.darktide.key.mode.asc: Veil on/off: ink hides you from mobs at a distance (drains Flow)
power.jaymospowers.darktide.key.special: Gedan: Stillwater (katana or empty hands, hold): stand still as a field spreads; let go to strike every foe in it from below
power.jaymospowers.darktide.key.ultimate: Hold: Maelstrom, a dome of dark water you swim through while everyone else in it drowns; hold again to bring it down. Sneak + %6$s: Tide Arms. Tap: the shadows are dormant while you're cured
Drown: fill a sphere around your target with water

Hold: Maelstrom, a dome of dark water you swim through while everyone else in it drowns. Tap: Necromancy, raise a harvested shadow to fight for you (a villager who was no guard goes back to its life instead). Sneak + %6$s: Tide Arms
message.jaymospowers.darktide.blade_only: Your hands are empty. This needs a blade.
message.jaymospowers.darktide.no_shadow: No water or shadow to surface in there.
message.jaymospowers.darktide.whisper_15: The blade remembers every blow it turned aside.
message.jaymospowers.darktide.whisper_30: Something deep beneath the water is listening to your steel.
message.jaymospowers.darktide.shadows_fu: You can hold no more shadows.
message.jaymospowers.darktide.shadow_los: The shadow slips away before it can stand.
message.jaymospowers.darktide.hollow_ris: %s gets up, brushes off the dust, and goes back to their life. Not quite right.
message.jaymospowers.darktide.no_weaponm: There are no blades in this world to shape the water into.
message.jaymospowers.darktide.shadows_do: The shadows sleep beneath still water.
message.jaymospowers.darktide.no_corpse: No body to draw a shadow from.
message.jaymospowers.darktide.mode_still: The water within you lies still.
message.jaymospowers.darktide.arms_no_bl: The water finds no blade of yours to follow.
message.jaymospowers.darktide.arms_need_: The water will only take the shape of a blade.
message.jaymospowers.darktide.cured: The deep water goes quiet. Something lets go of you, for now.
message.jaymospowers.darktide.corruption: Dusk falls, and the dark tide rises in you again.
message.jaymospowers.darktide.shade_rise: Your body falls, and your shadow stands up in its place. Keep out of the sun until nightfall.
message.jaymospowers.darktide.shade_dawn: The sky is paling. Find a roof: the sun will burn a shadow away.
message.jaymospowers.darktide.shade_sunl: The sun is on you! Your shadow is smouldering.
message.jaymospowers.darktide.shade_surv: Night falls again, and the dark gives you back your flesh.
death.attack.jaymospowers.darktide_dawn: %1$s's shadow burned away in the sun
%1$s's shadow burned away in the sun
message.jaymospowers.darktide.high_tide: High tide. The water reaches further.
message.jaymospowers.darktide.spring_tid: Spring tide. The next wave is the great one.
